info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to measure time, to preach, to explain on time

info.name: kOmudIDAtukramANkaH
info.value: ayaM DAtuH sidDAntakOmudyAm pfTag rUpeRa nEva pAWyate . parantu tatra 10.421 vela ityatra 'kAla iti pfTagDAturityeke' iti nirdeSena ayaM pAWaBedaH jYApitaH asti .

examples: 'yaTA paSUnAM saNGAtaM yazwyA pAlaH prakAlayet. taTA BImo gajAnIkaM gadayA samakAlayat' (BA॰BIzma॰62.63).. samakAlayat=akzipat=prAjat.
